# Destination photographs

Downloaded as 1200px JPEGs from Unsplash for the dream-destination collection. These are inspiration photographs, not a claim of personal visits.

- `japan.jpg`: Nicolas Jehly, [Mount Fuji framed by cherry blossoms](https://unsplash.com/photos/mt-fuji-is-framed-by-cherry-blossoms-in-the-foreground-DEXxCRUZtDo).
- `rome.jpg`: Mathew Schwartz, [Coliseum, Italy](https://unsplash.com/photos/coliseum-italy-s87bBFZviAU).
- `switzerland.jpg`: Robin Ulrich, [Lauterbrunnen](https://unsplash.com/photos/green-mountains-and-houses-during-daytime-bvSLu1Lew3Y).

All three are offered under the [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license). Each postcard includes its photographer credit and source link.

Plant illustrations are SVGs drawn in `reading.js`. No stock images are used as personal plant growth history. Growth photographs are supplied by the visitor and stored locally in their browser.
